verdict.rationale: The evidence shows incident.io tracks in-incident actions: it separates actions that "need doing now" from post-incident follow-ups, and incident actions can sync to Asana tickets. That gives thin support for the task-checklist half of the story. Nothing in the pack documents defined incident roles such as commander or comms lead. missing for 10: documented incident roles (commander/incident lead, comms lead) and role assignment, structured task checklists or templates per incident, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, incidents carry defined roles (commander, comms lead) and task checklists so response stays coordinated under pressure

citations.quote: We believe you create two types of actions during an incident – those that need doing now and those that should be followed up after an incident has been closed.
Export and automatically sync your incident actions with tickets in Asana.
